footer.privacy: Your designs stay on this device.

about.title: About {{appName}}
about.description: Make posters, flyers, cards, certificates and more, then print them at any size. Free for everyone.
about.privacyLocal: Designs and images are saved only in this browser, on this device.
about.privacyNoAccount: No account, no tracking, no ads.
about.privacyOffline: Keeps working without an internet connection.
about.privacySearch: Online image search is optional and only sends the words you search for.
about.license: Open source under the MIT license: free to use, change and share.

home.title: Design anything. Print any size.
home.subtitle: Free, private and made for everyone. Your designs never leave this device.
home.emptyBody: Pick a size above to start your first design.
home.templatesHint: Free templates you can change completely: text, colours, fonts and images.

trash.title: Recently deleted
trash.hint: Designs here are deleted forever after 30 days.
trash.confirmBody: “{{name}}” will be permanently removed from this device. This can’t be undone.

create.title: Create a design
create.description: Choose a size or enter your own. You can still print at any size later.
create.invalidSize: Enter a width and height between {{min}} and {{max}}.

design.actionFailed: That didn’t work. Please try again.
design.createFailed: Couldn’t create the design. Please try again.
design.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it was made in another browser or on another device.
design.inTrash: This design is in Recently deleted.

templates.personaliseBody: Edit every word, colour, font and image. Apply a style in one click, add your own artwork and save a reusable template. Your design stays on this device; no account is needed.
templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Free templates for print and social media. Pick one, then make it your own.
templates.mineEmpty: Templates you save from your own designs appear here. Open a design and choose Save as template.
templates.createFailed: Couldn’t create a design from this template. Please try again.
templates.saveDescription: Keep a copy of this design to start new designs from. Later changes to the design don’t change the template.
templates.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed from this device. Designs you made from it stay as they are.
templates.actionFailed: That didn’t work. Please try again.

styles.title: Styles
styles.hint: Templates use these colours and fonts, so one click restyles the whole design.

images.title: Images
images.description: Add your own photos and logos, pick a built-in graphic, or search free images online.
images.noUploads: Images you upload are saved on this device and appear here, ready to reuse.
images.libraryHint: Original graphics that follow your design’s colours. They work offline.
images.commercialOnly: Only images I can use commercially and edit
images.privacyNote: Only your search words are sent to {{provider}}. Check each image’s licence: most ask you to credit the creator.
images.disabled: Online image search is turned off.
images.offline: You’re offline. Your uploads and the library still work.
images.searchPrompt: Search millions of free, openly licensed images.
images.error: The search didn’t work. Check your connection and try again.
images.rateLimited: Too many searches in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
images.downloadError: That image couldn’t be downloaded. Try another one.

credit.title: Credit
credit.hint: This image’s licence may require you to credit its creator.

editor.canvasHelp: Drag elements to move them. Shift-click to select several. Double-click text to edit. Hold Space to pan, or pinch to zoom. All elements are also accessible in Layers.
editor.elementsHint: Add an outline icon or a decorative sticker. Everything stays on this device.
editor.imageError: That file couldn’t be added. Choose an image file and try again.

qr.editHint: This exact text is encoded. Use the QR button in the toolbar to create a link, Wi-Fi, contact or payment code.
qr.hint: Create a code that opens a link, joins Wi-Fi, starts an email, call, message or UPI payment.
qr.subject: Subject
qr.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
qr.missingFields: Fill in the required fields first.

editor.emptyHint: Add text or a shape, then select it to change its style. Drag on the page to select several elements.
editor.lockedHint: Unlock or show this element in Layers to edit it.
editor.layersHint: Front layers appear first. Drag to reorder, or select layers and use the arrows below.
editor.noLayers: Your page is ready. Add your first element above.
editor.saveError: Couldn’t save. Your changes are still in this tab. Free some device space and retry.
editor.saveConflict: This design changed in another tab. Save your work as a copy to keep both versions.
editor.saveDeleted: This design was deleted in another tab. Save your work as a copy to keep it.
editor.shortcutsHint: On phones, use the toolbar and Properties for precise edits. Two fingers pan and zoom.

print.title: Print or download
print.description: Print at true size on any paper, or save a PNG, JPG or PDF. Everything is prepared on this device.

layoutHints.single: Each page on its own sheet of paper.
layoutHints.multiple: As many copies as fit on each sheet, with marks to cut them out.
layoutHints.poster: Print larger than your paper: the design is split across sheets to join together.

print.posterScaleHint: Percent of the design size. The poster prints at {{size}}.
print.overlapHint: Repeated on neighbouring sheets, so you can line them up and glue or tape them.
print.marksHint: Thin lines outside the design show where to cut.
print.posterMarksHint: Marks show where each sheet's artwork starts; labels such as A1 and B2 give the order.
print.bleedHint: Colours and photos at the edge continue past the cut line, so no white slivers show after cutting.
print.safeMarginsHint: Most printers can't print right to the edge. Turn this off for borderless printing.
print.doesNotFit: The design is larger than this paper. Choose larger paper, Fit to paper, or Poster.
print.nothingFits: Not even one copy fits on this paper. Choose larger paper or turn off crop marks.
print.edgeHint: The design reaches the paper edge. Most printers leave a thin white border there; Fit to paper keeps everything visible.
print.limited: This job exceeds the preview limit ({{count}} sheets or 1,000 copies per page). Reduce copies or poster size, choose larger paper, or print the current page.
print.printHint: In the print window, choose {{paper}} paper, 100% / Actual size, no headers or footers, and background graphics on. “Save as PDF” keeps text sharp.
print.printDesignHint: In the print window, choose “Save as PDF” for a print-ready PDF at exactly this size, with sharp, selectable text.

formatHints.png: Sharp image for screens, social media and sharing.
formatHints.jpeg: Smaller image, good for photos and messaging.
formatHints.pdf: Document for printing, emailing or sending to a print shop.

print.reduced: Reduced to {{dpi}} DPI to stay within this browser’s image size limit.
print.pdfMarksHint: For print shops: the page grows to include bleed and crop marks.
print.pdfNote: Each PDF page is a high-resolution picture. For a PDF with selectable text, use Print and choose “Save as PDF”.
print.exportFailed: The file couldn’t be created. Check that images and fonts are available, or try a lower resolution.
print.printFailed: Printing couldn’t start. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Preferences are saved on this device.
settings.measureDescription: Used for showing sizes and suggesting paper sizes.
settings.storageDescription: Everything is saved in this browser, on this device only. Nothing is uploaded.
settings.storageUnknown: This browser doesn’t report storage usage.
settings.protected: Protected: the browser won’t clear your designs to free up space.
settings.notProtected: Not protected yet: the browser may clear data when the device is low on space.
settings.protectDenied: The browser didn’t allow it this time. Installing the app usually enables protection.
settings.clearWarning: Clearing this site’s data in your browser deletes your designs.
settings.onlineDescription: Optional services that need an internet connection. Your designs are never sent.
settings.imageSearchHint: Search free images from Openverse and Wikimedia Commons. Only the words you search for are sent.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you’re looking for doesn’t exist.
